messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed for /v1/generate in prod-us-east-1. p95 latency 1.2s -> 4.8s, p99 2.4s -> 18s. Error rate 5xx 0.8% -> 6.5%. Paging ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: I'm online. grabbing perf dashboards and request traces :eyes:

sara_dev: seeing a tail of stalled invocations on gw-proxy pods, connections piling, 502/504s. stack: nginx -> mux -> runtime. Starting live-capture of one failing trace.

leo_infra: looks like new kernel param change from today's infra rollout? deploy timeline shows api-service v2026-03-17-rc3 pushed ~5m before spike.

anita_pm: customer-impact estimate? any large customers affected?

cs_lead: preliminary: ~7 accounts with elevated errors; a couple of realtime apps are retrying. No escalations yet.

ops-oncall: collecting sample logs.

ops-oncall: ```
2026-03-17T14:02:11Z ERROR request_id=abc123 gateway: upstream timeout after 12000ms
2026-03-17T14:02:15Z WARN kvcache: large-eviction count=342
``` 

sara_dev: KV cache eviction spike concurrent with deploy. Could be model cache warming + new batch-scheduler flag.

leo_infra: rolling back v2026-03-17-rc3 now to previous stable (v2026-03-15-hotfix). Initiating rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollback started for service=api-service from v2026-03-17-rc3 -> v2026-03-15-hotfix (actioned by leo_infra)

ops-oncall: routing some traffic to fallback region (prod-eu-1) for high-traffic customers while rollback completes :arrows_clockwise: 

anita_pm: notify support to watch top 20 active sessions and inform 2 major accounts of transient errors. Keep messaging templated.

cs_lead: sending heads-up to affected customers now.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. All pods in api-service are at v2026-03-15-hotfix. Load healthy.

ops-oncall: metrics: p95 back to ~1.3s, p99 back to ~2.7s, 5xx rate down to 0.9%. Still watching for residuals.

sara_dev: postmortem action items: revert the kernel param change on infra rollout OR revert the batch-scheduler flag; instrument kvcache metrics per-pod; add canary thresholds for kv-evictions.

leo_infra: agreed. I'll open an infra PR to pin kernel settings and throttle the new flag in canary.

anita_pm: assigning incident-triage doc and severity 2. Will schedule postmortem meeting in 48h.

cs_lead: customer follow-up: outreach completed to affected accounts; offering support window. No SLA breaches detected so far.

ops-oncall: closing the pager. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED by ops-oncall at 2026-03-17T14:25:20Z
